note: GMUG (Gunnison NF) campground at ~9,600 ft at the end of FR 706 (Lost Lake Road), 2 miles off gravel Kebler Pass Road (CR 12) about 16 miles from Crested Butte, beside Lost Lake Slough near Lost Lake and Dollar Lake; some tent and horse sites. No motorboats on the slough. Campers report FR 706 as narrow dirt with tight turns, passable for cars and RVs to about 28-30 ft, with larger trailers discouraged. --Claude
summary: FS page: confirmed vault toilets, first-come only, $24 (2026). Added potable water (FS: available), season note, fees note. Stored max_rig_ft 28 left alone (no agency figure; see flags). Note trimmed of field facts and the outdated water caveat; road reports kept as camper-reported.
flags: Missing phone: Paonia Ranger District (970) 310-6383 (GMUG offices page; the campground's FS page has no office block).

Max length: the stored 28 ft (from note prose) is not an agency figure. Neither the FS page nor any recreation.gov listing gives a length or site count. Third-party: one aggregator says 32-ft max; a Dyrt reviewer's 28-ft camper fit, and another warned a 40-ft trailer would be challenging on the last 2 miles. No dated 23 ft+ review was found.
Status: FS Current Conditions 'NO SERVICE OR RESERVATIONS' with 'Site Open' (page updated September 29, 2026), so likely the post-season no-service period. Water may be off.
Road: no FS or GMUG alert wording on CR 12 or FR 706 (no RV or 4WD advice). The narrow/tight-turns text is camper-reported, kept in the note as such.

WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (stored lakeview): on Esri imagery, vehicles are parked in pull-outs along the north-shore road of Lost Lake Slough, ~15-30 m from the water with open grass between, while the west loops sit ~150-250 m back in trees. If the north-shore pull-outs are numbered campsites and not day-use or fishing parking, some sites may earn lakefront (a Dyrt reviewer mentions sites near the lake). Needs a site map.
Pin 38.8694,-107.2088 is ~25 m from the FS coordinate 38.86942,-107.20909, at the slough's north-west corner where FR 706 meets the campground roads. No catalog to compare. OK.
